notes: Disambiguation: registered name 'Autorijschool Valentina T.H.O.D.N. NXXT' (KvK 17260089, vestiging 000001800833, rijschoolnummer 5596W8) at Veldpad 19, 5236WK 's-Hertogenbosch; email valentinarijschool@gmail.com. Aggregators (clickdrive.nl, educarplatform.nl, rijschoolspecialist.nl) refer to it as 'Valentina Rijschool'. T.H.O.D.N. = 'tevens handelend onder de naam' NXXT franchise; CompanyInfo notes the org changed its name on 2025-09-01 (rebrand into NXXT). Note the SAME address Veldpad 19 also hosts NXXT instructor 'Augustina van der Steen' / 'Van der Steen t.h.o.d.n. NXXT' on nxxt.nl, so the NXXT public pages do not cleanly map to this specific Valentina entity. Only category B (personenauto) offered; one CBR exam location (Den Bosch). CBR: 45 first exams, 49% first-time pass (59% school overall). No evidence found for English instruction or transmission type (automaat vs schakel) - both unknown. Founding conflicting: EduCar '16 jaar geleden' (~2010), clickdrive '17 jaar ervaring' (~2009); both are aggregator estimates (low confidence); KvK 2025 event is a name change, not founding. Phones vary across sources: (073) 622 19 18 (CBR), 06 12 43 43 08, +31736221918. Google rating 3.9/5 from only 7 reviews, several of which are flagged by a reviewer as self-/related-school 5-star ratings; two recent 1-star reviews allege cancelled appointments and lost money.
